Writes the file a preview of the same change would write, or nothing. The file is written only when its current revision matches base_revision (else 409 stale) and, when expect_result_revision is given, the recomputed result matches it (else 409 changed). A new table creates `mapping/codetables/<id>.lua`. The change is left uncommitted in the caller's dev clone. A node that follows a catalog is refused (409 catalog_linked).
